curve.aggregation_and_uncertainty: Spearman correlation across the original assay rows. Percentile 95% intervals use 10,000 whole-protein bootstrap draws, retaining all assays of each selected protein and reranking each expanded draw. No iid analytic p-values or bootstrap-tail p-values. Assay and protein counts are reported; intervals are nominal and are not adjusted for the exploratory comparisons.

limitations: Protein-cluster uncertainty is conditional on this retained assay panel. The intervals are pointwise and do not correct for multiple exploratory comparisons.
